recommended_research_directions: Monitor future issuer or customer-official disclosures for signed HBM purchase obligations, numeric volume, price, period, cancellation terms and allocation protection; do not infer them from collaboration or requested production quantities.

Reconcile subsequent actual HBM revenue or mix, margin, CAPEX, working capital and free-cash conversion to the existing consolidated and DRAM actuals without reallocating company-wide numbers by assumption.
Track HBM-only capacity, utilization, packaging output and sold-out period separately from memory-wide utilization and qualitative M15X, Yongin and packaging investment plans.
Compare future actual earnings and cash conversion against the stated forward valuation and revision denominators, keeping derived scenarios distinct from issuer guidance and realized results.
Preserve customer concentration, inventory and receivable conversion, warranty and contract-loss provisions, dilution and non-operating gains as continuing counter and supersession checks.
resolved_challenges: Pure-story challenge is resolved in part: FY2025 HBM sales grew more than twofold, HBM contributed to the high-value product basket, and customer-requested HBM4 quantities were already in mass production. These are product and revenue-conversion actuals, not signed contract economics.

Company-wide earnings and liquidity existence is resolved by OPENDART actuals, strong 2026Q1 consolidated profit and operating cash flow, net-cash capacity, and an unmodified audit opinion. The resolution remains consolidated or DRAM-wide and does not create HBM-only EPS or FCF.

The prior structured valuation coverage gap is resolved at review level because CURRENT_VALUATION and DURABLE_VISIBILITY are both populated. This confirms a usable comparison plane, not that the security is cheap or that issuer plans are legally committed demand.

Near-term supply tension is source-backed at the memory-wide level through 100% utilization and demand exceeding supply capability. This resolves absence of any operating bottleneck signal but not HBM-only locked capacity or a long-duration sold-out period.
unresolved_challenges: eps_fcf_explosion: consolidated earnings and operating cash flow, and DRAM revenue, still lack an HBM-only revenue, margin, EPS, CAPEX, working-capital, tax and FCF bridge; increased CAPEX cash outflow, receivables, inventory and non-operating dividend receipts limit cash-conversion attribution.

earnings_visibility: customer-requested HBM4 production and issuer demand outlook do not disclose named-customer purchase obligations, fixed price, committed volume, duration, cancellation protection, advance payment, RPO or backlog; monthly or quarterly price-volume agreement keeps contract visibility short.

bottleneck_pricing: 100% utilization and demand exceeding supply are memory-wide, while inventory valuation, WIP and contract-loss provisions remain current counters; HBM-only capacity allocation, sold-out duration and realized ASP uplift are not disclosed.

market_mispricing: strong operating actuals are not connected to an attributable pre-existing market expectation or HBM-only surprise bridge, so current price and revision data cannot by themselves prove a pricing error.

valuation_rerating: forward PE is low relative to growth, but forward EV/EBITDA and PB, trailing PE and PB, and thin forward FCF yield provide conflicting signals; HBM-only earnings and cash denominators remain unavailable.

capital_allocation: net cash, debt reduction, dividend and share cancellation are positive actuals, but issuer-wide CAPEX, R&D, receivable and inventory growth, exchangeable-bond dilution and lease obligations are not joined to HBM-only realized ROIC.

information_confidence: regulated actuals and the audit opinion are reliable at company level, but HBM product, demand and customer-collaboration claims remain principally issuer-sourced; presentation non-verification, incomplete-review and quarterly disclosure limitations remain open monitoring constraints.

Across components, large level-three valuation gains, financial-instrument gains, FX and derivative sensitivity must remain separate from recurring HBM operating profitability, while customer concentration prevents treating demand strength as diversified contract durability.
